_fixture.reference: P16 Protocol Phase II Ver 1.0 (TRC160334, ulcerative colitis): page 34 visit grid, page 57-58 extension follow-up and closure. Only the timing summary in docs/protocol-schedule-schema-analysis.md and the CBS corpus case were available; participants, sites and dates are invented.
assumptions: B-A1 Day 1 is randomization; Visits 3-6 are Weeks 2, 4, 8 and 12 (+/-2 days), Visit 7 is Week 13 (+3 days, none early) and Visit 8/EOS is Week 37 (+/-7 days), all from randomization.
B-A2 Phases are read from recorded dates: treatment from randomization until Visit 6, safety follow-up from Visit 6 until Visit 7, extension from Visit 7 until Visit 8. Withdrawal ends participation.

B-A3 When the final participant in the study completes Visit 6, participants in extension on that date are called back for one early end-of-study visit on the site's next available date, which replaces their routine Visit 8.
B-A4 The final participant completes Visit 7 and then exits: their Visit 8 (the extension end) is superseded.
B-A5 Participants between Visit 6 and Visit 7 on that date (other than the final one) are listed for review: the protocol summary does not say whether they still enter extension.
B-A6 Only sponsor or CRO study users confirm the event; site PI/CRC book the early visit for their own participants.
